items.title: Alcoholism & High-Stakes Dramas
items.text: Flight 2012 · 2h 18m · R 7.3/10 · YouTube +7 Stars Denzel Washington as an airline pilot whose drinking is uncovered after an emergency landing. Days of Wine and Roses 1962 · 1h 57m · Not Rated 7.8/10 · YouTube +4 A classic drama about a couple who fall into shared alcoholism. The Lost Weekend 1945 · 1h 41m · Not Rated 7.8/10 · Fandango +4 Follows a writer's destructive binge-drinking weekend and its toll on those around him. Leaving Las Vegas 1995 · 1h 52m · R 7.5/10 · PLEX +13 A bleak drama about a screenwriter who moves to Las Vegas to drink himself to death. A Star Is Born 2018 · 2h 15m · R 7.6/10 · Pluto TV +5 Explores fame, co-dependency, and a musician's battle with alcohol. Warrior 2011 · 2h 20m · PG-13 8.1/10 · Pluto TV +8 Features Nick Nolte as a recovering alcoholic; there is a consensus on Reddit that his relapse scene is a particularly realistic portrayal of alcoholism.
